cases.question: 统计每个部门分别有多少名员工。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  department_id,
  COUNT(id) AS employee_count
FROM employees
GROUP BY
  department_id
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 统计每个部门的平均工资，按平均工资从高到低排序。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  department_id,
  AVG(salary) AS average_salary
FROM employees
GROUP BY
  department_id
ORDER BY
  average_salary DESC
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 列出工资高于 8000 的员工姓名、部门和工资。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  name,
  department_id,
  salary
FROM employees
WHERE
  salary > 8000
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 按部门统计销售额总和，显示部门名称和总销售额。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  d.name AS department_name,
  SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM sales AS s
JOIN employees AS e
  ON s.employee_id = e.id
JOIN departments AS d
  ON e.department_id = d.id
GROUP BY
  d.name
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 统计每个地址类型的记录数量。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  address_type,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM addr_standard_address
GROUP BY
  address_type
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 按行政区划统计地址记录数量，按数量降序排列。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  province_code,
  city_code,
  district_code,
  COUNT(*) AS address_count
FROM addr_standard_address
GROUP BY
  province_code,
  city_code,
  district_code
ORDER BY
  address_count DESC
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 查询张三当前住址对应的标准地址。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  sa.full_address
FROM person_basic AS pb
JOIN person_address_relation AS par
  ON pb.person_code = par.person_code
JOIN house_info AS hi
  ON par.house_code = hi.house_code
JOIN addr_standard_address AS sa
  ON hi.std_address_code = sa.std_address_code
WHERE
  pb.name = '张三' AND par.is_current = 1
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 查询包含人民路的地址别名及对应标准地址。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  aa.alias_name,
  sa.full_address
FROM addr_alias AS aa
JOIN addr_standard_address AS sa
  ON aa.std_address_code = sa.std_address_code
WHERE
  aa.alias_name LIKE '%人民路%'
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 统计每个交易所的股票数量。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  exchange_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT symbol) AS stock_count
FROM stock_symbols
GROUP BY
  exchange_code
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 成交量最高的前 10 只股票是哪些？
cases.sql:
SELECT
  s.symbol,
  s.chinese_name,
  sd.volume AS highest_volume
FROM stock_daily_prices AS sd
JOIN stock_symbols AS s
  ON sd.symbol = s.symbol
ORDER BY
  sd.volume DESC
LIMIT 10

cases.question: 苹果公司最新收盘价是多少？
cases.sql:
SELECT
  sdp.close_price AS 最新收盘价
FROM stock_symbols AS ss
JOIN stock_daily_prices AS sdp
  ON ss.symbol = sdp.symbol
WHERE
  ss.chinese_name = '苹果公司'
ORDER BY
  sdp.trade_date DESC
LIMIT 1

cases.question: 哪些是杠杆 ETF？显示代码、名称、杠杆倍数和底层资产。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  s.symbol AS 代码,
  s.chinese_name AS 名称,
  sedm.leveraged_ratio AS 杠杆倍数,
  sedm.underlying_asset AS 底层资产
FROM stock_symbols AS s
JOIN stock_etp_metadata AS sedm
  ON s.symbol = sedm.symbol
WHERE
  sedm.etp_type = 'ETF' AND sedm.leveraged_flag = TRUE
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 哪些是反向 ETF？显示代码、名称和底层资产。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  s.symbol AS 代码,
  s.chinese_name AS 名称,
  sed.underlying_asset
FROM stock_symbols AS s
JOIN stock_etp_metadata AS sed
  ON s.symbol = sed.symbol
WHERE
  sed.inverse_flag = TRUE
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: SIC 3571 行业以及它的上级行业是什么？
cases.sql:
WITH industry_tree AS (
  SELECT
    sic_code,
    chinese_name,
    parent_sic_code
  FROM stock_industry_classification
  WHERE
    sic_code = '3571'
)
SELECT
  t1.chinese_name AS current_industry,
  COALESCE(t2.chinese_name, '无上级行业') AS upper_industry
FROM industry_tree AS t1
LEFT JOIN stock_industry_classification AS t2
  ON t1.sic_code = t2.parent_sic_code
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 统计每个城市的客户数量，按数量降序排列。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  city,
  COUNT(id) AS customer_count
FROM customers
GROUP BY
  city
ORDER BY
  customer_count DESC
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 列出每个客户的总消费金额，按金额降序取前 10 名。
cases.sql:
WITH CustomerTotalSpending AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    SUM(total_amount) AS total_spent
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY
    customer_id
)
SELECT
  c.id AS customer_id,
  c.name AS customer_name,
  ct.total_spent
FROM customers AS c
JOIN CustomerTotalSpending AS ct
  ON c.id = ct.customer_id
ORDER BY
  ct.total_spent DESC
LIMIT 10

cases.question: 查找买过 iPhone 15 Pro 的客户姓名和城市。
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  c.name,
  c.city
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
  ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items AS oi
  ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE
  p.name = 'iPhone 15 Pro'
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 按月统计 2024 年订单总金额。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  SUM(total_amount) AS total_order_amount
FROM orders
WHERE
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2024
GROUP BY
  TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY
  month
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 统计每个城市的客户数量，按数量降序排列。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  CITY,
  COUNT(ID) AS customer_count
FROM CUSTOMERS
GROUP BY
  CITY
ORDER BY
  customer_count DESC
FETCH FIRST 1000 ROWS ONLY

cases.question: 列出每个客户的总消费金额，按金额降序取前 10 名。
cases.sql: WITH CustomerTotalSpent AS ( SELECT o.CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(o.TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS total_spent FROM ORDERS o GROUP BY o.CUSTOMER_ID ) SELECT c.ID, c.NAME, ct.total_spent FROM Customers c JOIN CustomerTotalSpent ct ON c.ID = ct.CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY ct.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

cases.question: 查找买过 iPhone 15 Pro 的客户姓名和城市。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  c.NAME,
  c.CITY
FROM CUSTOMERS c
JOIN ORDERS o
  ON c.ID = o.CUSTOMER_ID
JOIN ORDER_ITEMS oi
  ON o.ID = oi.ORDER_ID
JOIN PRODUCTS p
  ON oi.PRODUCT_ID = p.ID
WHERE
  p.NAME = 'iPhone 15 Pro'
FETCH FIRST 1000 ROWS ONLY

cases.question: 按月统计 2024 年订单总金额。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS total_amount
FROM ORDERS
WHERE
  ORDER_DATE >= '2024-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY
  TO_CHAR(ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY
  month
FETCH FIRST 1000 ROWS ONLY

cases.question: 统计每个城市的销售总额 Top 5。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  T2.city,
  SUM(T1.gmv)
FROM hadoop_order_events AS T1
JOIN hadoop_region_dim AS T2
  ON T1.region_id = T2.region_id
GROUP BY
  T2.city
ORDER BY
  SUM(T1.gmv) DESC
LIMIT 5

cases.question: 统计 VIP 5 用户贡献的成交金额。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(gmv)
FROM hadoop_order_events AS T1
INNER JOIN hadoop_user_profiles AS T2
  ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id
WHERE
  T2.vip_level = 5
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 统计各品牌每月销量趋势。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  p.brand,
  SUBSTRING(e.event_date, 1, 7) AS month,
  SUM(e.order_count) AS total_sales
FROM hadoop_order_events AS e
JOIN hadoop_product_dim AS p
  ON e.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY
  p.brand,
  SUBSTRING(e.event_date, 1, 7)
ORDER BY
  p.brand,
  month
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 统计每个省份的订单数和成交金额。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  T2.province,
  SUM(T1.order_count),
  SUM(T1.gmv)
FROM hadoop_order_events AS T1
INNER JOIN hadoop_region_dim AS T2
  ON T1.region_id = T2.region_id
GROUP BY
  T2.province
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 统计每个洲分别有多少个国家。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  continent_name,
  COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM countries
GROUP BY
  continent_name
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 列出亚洲国家的名称、首都和货币。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  name,
  capital,
  currency
FROM countries
WHERE
  continent_name = 'Asia'
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 找出使用 English 且货币包含 USD 的国家，显示国家、首都和所属洲。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  name,
  capital,
  continent_name
FROM countries
WHERE
  languages LIKE '%English%' AND currency LIKE '%USD%'
LIMIT 1000

cases.question: 统计每种货币对应的国家数量，按数量降序排列。
cases.sql:
SELECT
  currency,
  COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM countries
GROUP BY
  currency
ORDER BY
  country_count DESC
LIMIT 1000
